intelligence.executive_summary: Overall dispatch volume declined 17% MoM, representing a loss of 3973.52 MT. This downturn is primarily attributed to significant drops in West Bengal and Uttar Pradesh, which together account for 75% of the total volume lost. A critical dispatch bottleneck continues, with 95645.32 MT in pending orders and an 83% dispatch-order gap severely limiting throughput. The high count of 163 inactive and several severely declining dealers exacerbates the sales challenge. Immediate action is required to clear the dispatch backlog and re-engage critical dealers to recover lost volumes.

root_cause_analysis.finding: West Bengal experienced the largest volume drop, declining by 2023.86 MT (18% MoM), contributing 51% to the total decline.
IG (Iron Gate) volume decreased by 3179.64 MT, an 18% MoM reduction, making up 80% of the total volume loss.
Uttar Pradesh saw a significant 968.38 MT decline (25% MoM), contributing 24% to the overall loss.
Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh, recorded a substantial 552.38 MT drop, a 58% MoM reduction, accounting for 14% of the total decline.
KIRAN ENTERPRISES in Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh, declined by 529.65 MT, representing a 64% MoM drop and 13% of the total volume loss.
Murshidabad, West Bengal, declined by 468.47 MT, a 34% MoM reduction, contributing 12% to the total decline.

dealer_risks.recommended_action: ASM for Varanasi to contact KIRAN ENTERPRISES within 24 hours to investigate the 64% MoM decline and identify immediate remedial actions for volume recovery.
ASM for Murshidabad to engage KALIMATA HARDWARE within 48 hours to address the 41% MoM drop and secure outstanding orders.
ASM for Verbal to reactivate MAHAVEER IRON- SONU within this week, targeting recovery of their previous 142.79 MT volume, primarily in IG.
ASM for DARRANG to reach out to SHAKTI INDUSTRIES this week to understand their inactivity and bring back previous IG and P orders totaling 126.12 MT.

intelligence.geographic_insights: The majority of the total volume loss is concentrated in West Bengal (51%) and Uttar Pradesh (24%). Within West Bengal, Murshidabad and Verbal districts are significant contributors to the decline, while North 24 Parganas also shows a notable drop. In Uttar Pradesh, Varanasi district's 58% MoM reduction is a primary concern. Tripura experienced a substantial 45% decline, warranting closer inspection. Odisha and Assam have shown relatively better stability with single-digit percentage declines. The overall concentration risk remains low among the top 3 dealers despite individual dealer performance issues.

recommended_actions.action: Dispatch team to prioritize and clear a minimum of 20,000 MT from the 95645.32 MT pending orders within the next 48 hours, focusing on orders for West Bengal and Uttar Pradesh to reduce the 83% dispatch-order gap.

Sales Managers for West Bengal and Uttar Pradesh to conduct a joint review with ASMs for Varanasi, Murshidabad, and Verbal districts within 24 hours to formulate specific recovery plans for declining dealers and address local market conditions.
ASMs in all regions to engage the top 20 inactive dealers by previous volume within this week to understand reasons for cessation and secure new orders, especially for IG products.

Owner to initiate an internal review of the 18% MoM decline in the IG product category to assess competitive pricing, inventory availability, and market demand shifts relative to other product offerings.
